ack_vs_execution.rule: An MQTT PUBACK is broker receipt, and a device ACK is protocol evidence; neither is device execution.
ack_vs_execution.stated_by_backend: backend/src/coldguard_backend/mqtt_consumer.py:12-31 (the PUBACK is not the authority for durably processed) and backend/src/coldguard_backend/simulator.py:22
ack_vs_execution.stated_by_device: firmware/main/cg_command.h:48-54 (an ACK is protocol evidence, never physical evidence; in this build the applied state an ACK can ever report is OFF)
ack_vs_execution.residual_defect: The loop is still not closable: the device has no transport, so no ACK of any kind can be delivered, and the applied state is compiled out. A-W06-05/06 remain open physically.

grammars.telemetry_serial_frame: prefix '#CG' + kind 'TELEM' (coldguard_config.h:552 and :568), single space separators, one trailing '\n', no '=' inside values, no duplicate keys, no empty tokens (cg_telemetry_schema.py:432-446); max CG_TELEMETRY_LINE_MAX=3072 bytes (coldguard_config.h:474); the formatter refuses to emit a truncated frame (cg_telemetry.c:33-39,387-390); floats printed %.4f, missing number is the literal 'nan' (CG_INVALID_VALUE_TOKEN, coldguard_config.h:577); fault_code printed 0x%08lX; age fields saturate at 2^64-1 on clock rewind (cg_telemetry.c:67-73)
grammars.command_ack_frame: #CG CMDACK schema=1 event=ACK command_id=<id> command_id_form=<UUID|TEST_TOKEN|NONE> source=<NETWORK|LOCAL_CONSOLE|UNKNOWN> device_id=<id> boot_id=<id> boot_count=<n> uptime_ms=<n> ack_seq=<n> status=<7-token ACK set> reason=<stable token> desired_cooling=<ON|OFF> desired_duty_permille=<int> applied_cooling=<ON|OFF> applied_duty_permille=<int> reapplied=<0|1> expiry_evaluable=<0|1> time_sync_state=<SYNCHRONIZED|UNSYNCHRONIZED> device_mode=<token> fault_code=0x<8hex> [canonical_status=<token> when DUPLICATE_CANONICAL] [output_stage=<ENABLED|DISABLED> allowed_duty_max_permille=<int> when context supplied] - cg_command.c:447-480. schema=1 here is the docs/02 command envelope version, NOT the serial telemetry schema (cg_log.h:26-28, cg_command.h:241-243).
grammars.command_device_encoding: space-separated key=value, exactly the 10 names at cg_command.c:558-561, all mandatory except controller_id (cg_command.c:576-586), record <= CG_COMMAND_RECORD_MAX=512 bytes, unknown key -> UNKNOWN_FIELD, duplicate key -> DUPLICATE_FIELD, at most CG_CMD_FIELDS_MAX=24 key=value tokens per record (cg_command.c:13, :630)
